Review Sleepagotchi?

Reviewers largely say Sleepagotchi makes sleep routines easier to stick to by turning bedtime and wake-up consistency into a simple daily game. The most repeated praise is that rewards, room decoration, and cute visuals make users look forward to waking up, while the UI feels clear and easy to use. Several testers say it helped them keep steadier sleep hours and feel better rested. The main caveat is that it still feels early: reviewers mention missing features, occasional performance or data-update issues, limited flexibility in changing schedules, and interest in broader device and platform support.

Simple UI, Kawaii designs, and exciting community events! I've looked forward to sleep since I started Sleepagotchi. The app has made my sleep better and my body clock is getting right. I'm expecting below improvements. - The app performance and correct data updating. - That we must change our sleep schedules on the day before. (On days when we have urgent plans or events, we will earn fewer tokens, our motivations will go down...) - Without token, nothing can be done that day. Sometimes I get bored. (But I think it's also an advantage of Gotchi, because we don't play games or use our phones too much.) Also we'd like to learn more about future outlook on Token economics :D
